<!-- Champs obligatoires -->
<input type="text" name="nom" required placeholder="Nom obligatoire">

<!-- Contraintes de longueur -->
<input type="text" name="username" 
       minlength="3" 
       maxlength="20" 
       placeholder="3-20 caractères">

<!-- Motif regex -->
<input type="text" name="code_postal" 
       pattern="[0-9]{5}" 
       placeholder="Code postal (5 chiffres)"
       title="Le code postal doit contenir 5 chiffres">

<!-- Auto-complétion -->
<input type="email" name="email" 
       autocomplete="email"
       list="emails">
<datalist id="emails">
  <option value="user@gmail.com">
  <option value="user@yahoo.com">
  <option value="user@hotmail.com">
</datalist>

<!-- Champ en lecture seule -->
<input type="text" name="id" value="12345" readonly>

a. Canvas de Base.code:
<!-- Canvas HTML -->
<canvas id="monCanvas" width="400" height="300">
  Votre navigateur ne supporte pas Canvas.
</canvas>

<!-- JavaScript pour dessiner -->
<script>
  const canvas = document.getElementById('monCanvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Rectangle
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6b6b';
  ctx.fillRect(50, 50, 100, 80);
  
  // Cercle
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(250, 90, 40, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
  ctx.fillStyle = '#4ecdc4';
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Ligne
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(50, 200);
  ctx.lineTo(350, 250);
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#45b7d1';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  ctx.stroke();
</script>
